text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: routing-policy-service in prod (us-east-1) is reporting repeated policy eval failures and elevated 5xxs. Paging oncall. thread=2109876543

maria (oncall): saw the alert. jumping in. are we seeing customer impact?

alan (support): multiple customers reported degraded responses and occasional long latencies. Support tickets 8123, 8124 mention fallback loops sending requests across regions.

kevin (sre): graphs: rpc-errors on routing-policy-service spiked at 09:12 UTC. error rate ~18% for 10m. latency tail increased.

sam (eng-runtime): logs show repeated panics from the policy evaluator. snippet:```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
  at github.com/redwood/routing/policy/eval.go:142
  eval: "user.segment == 'enterprise' && modelVariant == 'redwood-13b-q4'"
```

maria (oncall): that expression string looks normal... could it be a missing attribute for some requests? any malformed rules?

sam (eng-runtime): we found one policy with a computed attribute `regionHints::list` (note the double-colon) that failed parsing in the new expression parser. parse error shows: `unexpected token '::' at position 23` before the panic. parser didn't surface gracefully and led to nil in evaluator.

kevin (sre): aha. malformed expression -> eval runaway -> panic -> route decision not set -> request hits fallback which chooses different region -> that region's policy also unhappy -> circular fallback. confirms customer reports.

alan (support): which customers are affected? tagging account owners.

eva (product): marking high priority. affected tenants: beta-fintech, docs.ai, imagegen-inc. beta-fintech has real-time SLAs, pushing this up.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigation: disable dynamic policy evaluation for routing-policy-service and switch to default static routing. runtime flag: `dynamic_routing=false` on the service. I'll flip it.

kevin (sre): +1. also enable lock-step fallback to a single stable model variant instead of per-request fallback. applying patch to config:```yaml
routing: 
  policy_mode: static
  static_route: redwood-stable-v1
  allow_cross_region_fallback: false
```

sam (eng-runtime): I'm pushing a tiny hotfix to the policy evaluator to catch parse errors and return an explicit `eval_error` branch instead of panicking. patch in PR 4521. will roll to canary after we stabilize traffic.

maria (oncall): dynamic_routing=false applied at 09:22 UTC. I'm watching request flow.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rolling update started for routing-policy-service canary (tag: patch-4521)

maria (oncall): after disabling dynamic routing, 5xxs dropped to baseline in 3 mins. latency tail coming down. customers show recovery but some requests earlier hit bad fallbacks.

alan (support): contacted beta-fintech and docs.ai. they saw intermittent misroutes between us-east-1 and eu-west-1 from 09:12-09:23 UTC. we offered mitigation steps and a follow-up postmortem.

kevin (sre): recommending we revoke the malformed policy rule from org-level policy store. sam, can you run a query to find policy rules containing `::` or other invalid tokens?

sam (eng-runtime): running search now. found 4 rules (orgs: beta-fintech, internal-testing, partner-x, docs.ai) with the `::` token. I'll auto-rollback those entries and add validation to the policy-upload pipeline.

maria (oncall): handoff to night oncall in 2 hours. will keep monitoring until next shift. I will leave the service in static mode until we get a safe rollout for the parser fix.

eva (product): customer impact note: some realtime features degraded ~11min; estimate 3% of requests affected for large tenants. please include this in the incident report.

kevin (sre): next steps: 1) emergency rollback of malformed rules (sam) 2) merge & canary deploy parser fix (sam) 3) add server-side catch for eval errors to avoid panics (sam) 4) config hardening to prevent circular region fallback (maria/infra) 5) postmortem + action items (owner: kevin).

sam (eng-runtime): PR 4521 merged to canary at 09:35 UTC. canary looks clean. scheduling prod rollout in 20m after additional smoke tests.

maria (oncall): leaving a short note for next oncall: service stable in static mode, parser fix in canary, removed offending rules, customers notified. handoff ETA 11:22 UTC to jose (next).

alan (support): will follow up with affected customers with summary and ETA for permanent fix.

incident-bot: reminder: create incident ticket: INC-2026-345 and assign to kevin (sre).

kevin (sre): creating ticket and starting timeline doc. will capture exact error traces and affected tenants. thanks team. :thumbsup:

maria (oncall): ack. leaving channel and marking as acknowledged. if regressions pop, ping me directly.

sam (eng-runtime): I'll add input validation into the policy-upload API and a CI check to reject expressions with unknown tokens. also adding a fallback metric to alert on-eval-failure > 0.1%.

kevin (sre): postmortem owner assigned. closing paging loop but keeping channel open for follow-ups.

maria (oncall): last check before handoff: 09:43 UTC, error rate normal. handing off.

jose (next oncall): taking over at 11:22 UTC, noted.
